purpose: Teach: 下っ/膨らま/別物/呼べる/挙動/利き/積もっ/引き込ま

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、私も会社では下っ端だった。
lines.en: When I was younger, I was at the bottom of the company too.
lines.style: Gentle, measured opening. A quiet nod backward in time. Warm acknowledgment of shared experience. Slight pause before speaking, as if reaching for an old memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。お焼き餅、お祖母ちゃんが、ふっくら膨らませてくれたわね。
lines.en: Yes. Those grilled mochi — your grandmother used to puff them up so beautifully.
lines.style: Voice softens on the memory. Tender, almost reverie-like. Light touch of affection on the image. Trailing off gently, as if seeing it again.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔の電車と、今の電車、別物だな。
lines.en: The trains back then and the trains now — they're completely different things.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to himself. A small, wondering tone. Not sad, just noting the distance time has made. Slight emphasis on the separation between then and now.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 孫を呼べる時間、何よりの楽しみ。
lines.en: Being able to call my grandchild over — there's no greater joy than that.
lines.style: Direct and simple, but weighted with genuine feeling. Voice steadies on what truly matters. Not sentimental, just honest. A small, satisfied breath at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 最近、ねこの挙動、ちょっと変だな。
lines.en: The cat's been acting a bit strange lately.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation, but with a thread of quiet concern underneath. Not alarmed — just noticing. The tone of someone who watches carefully.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔の写真、お父さん、左利きだったわね。
lines.en: That old photograph — your father was left-handed, wasn't he.
lines.style: Gentle recognizing tone, as if the memory has just surfaced. A small, wistful smile in the voice. Not a question, but phrased as one — inviting her to remember with him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 庭、二人で見た雪、忘れずに積もってる。
lines.en: The snow in the garden that we watched together — it's still there, unforgotten.
lines.style: Quiet, almost reverent. Each phrase given space to settle. Voice slows on 'watched together.' Tender but steady. A moment held in the present tense of memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔の物語、お互い、引き込まれて読んだわね。
lines.en: Those old stories — we used to get so drawn into reading them together.
lines.style: Warmth and closeness woven through. Voice opens slightly, inviting her into the shared space of the memory. Nostalgic but present. A soft rhythm, like settling into an old familiar moment.
